why: With no tracked `.schema.json` there is no contract to age in silence, and the rule has no object. The branch matters because the positive side of it is a SUBSTRING search over the text of every source: without the guard, a repository with no schema at all would go through a path that was never exercised, and "passou" there is a claim about zero files. The `pass` side has real code and no schema; the `fail` side has `esquemas/pessoa.schema.json` that nobody cites and keeps failing. "passou" stays Portuguese: it is the state value prove.mjs matches on (prove.mjs:198-200), not prose.
